package rulefixtures

	"bytes"

// scenario for bytes_splitaftern_two_index_zero_cut: `bytes.SplitAfterN(..., 2)[0]` instead of a two-part `bytes.Cut(...)` flow.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario463Positive(data []byte, sep []byte) []byte {
	return bytes.SplitAfterN(data, sep, 2)[0]
}
